title: Capital.com plans UAE spot crypto services after affiliate wins licence
summary: UAE clients will be able to buy and hold crypto through Capital.com’s app, expanding beyond price exposure through contracts for difference.
content: Capital.com plans to launch spot cryptocurrency services in the United Arab Emirates following a regulatory licence win by an affiliate. The expansion will allow clients in the region to buy and hold digital assets directly through the platform's mobile application, moving beyond traditional contracts for difference that only offered price exposure.

A $2 million bet on XRP volatility crosses the tape as prices surge
summary: An options trader opened a large straddle on XRP, betting on wild price swings by Aug. 28.
content:
Institutional derivatives traders executed a massive $2 million volatility position on XRP options as spot prices staged a sharp upward rally.
The high-stakes trade, routed via major crypto derivatives venues, appears to be structured as a long straddle or strangle strategy.
By betting heavily on price swings rather than pure directional bias, the trader is capitalizing on surging implied volatility and upcoming catalyst events.
The influx of whale-sized options activity coincides with a rapid spike in XRP derivatives open interest and daily contract volume.
Market analysts note that such sizeable volatility plays often precede wider breakout expansions or sharp, multi-directional market re-pricings.
